descriptionPlain:
Want to help shape the future of eCommerce in Australia and New Zealand within a successful and rapidly growing team? A role within our Marketplace Team could be just what you're looking for!
We have a fantastic new opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join the team! Reporting to our Head of Sales – Marketplace, this role will support the acquisition and growth of new sellers, helping to bring the most relevant, best-priced product ranges onboard to further our customer choice. In this role, you will be instrumental in learning the ropes of marketplace dynamics while driving growth across both the Kogan.com and Mighty Ape platforms.
We’re looking for a motivated, commercially-minded, and customer-centric individual who is eager to identify new opportunities and help innovate our Marketplace offering. You’ll be part of a fast-paced, constantly evolving business where your agility and ability to respond to market trends will be the key to your success!
Whether you have a couple of years in a Sales/ Commercial environment and are now looking to explore your passion for eCommerce and technology, or are a Junior Category Coordinator / Assistant Buyer looking to transition from traditional retail into the exciting world of pure-play online retail, we want to hear from you.  Above all, you are driven by customer-centric outcomes and are excited about creating the best possible experience for our community of sellers and customers alike.

Want to help shape the future of eCommerce in Australia and New Zealand within a successful and rapidly growing team? A role within our Marketplace Team could be just what you're looking for!

We have a fantastic new opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join the team! Reporting to our Head of Sales – Marketplace, this role will support the acquisition and growth of new sellers, helping to bring the most relevant, best-priced product ranges onboard to further our customer choice. In this role, you will be instrumental in learning the ropes of marketplace dynamics while driving growth across both the Kogan.com and Mighty Ape platforms.

We’re looking for a motivated, commercially-minded, and customer-centric individual who is eager to identify new opportunities and help innovate our Marketplace offering. You’ll be part of a fast-paced, constantly evolving business where your agility and ability to respond to market trends will be the key to your success!

Whether you have a couple of years in a Sales/ Commercial environment and are now looking to explore your passion for eCommerce and technology, or are a Junior Category Coordinator / Assistant Buyer looking to transition from traditional retail into the exciting world of pure-play online retail, we want to hear from you.  Above all, you are driven by customer-centric outcomes and are excited about creating the best possible experience for our community of sellers and customers alike.

lists.text: In this role you'll be responsible for:
lists.content:
• Identifying and Onboarding New Sellers: Proactively seek out potential sellers that align with our marketplace’s strategic goals and customer needs.
  • Vetting Incoming Leads: Assess incoming seller applications to ensure they meet our standards and criteria.
  • Building Strong Seller Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing sellers to ensure ongoing collaboration and success.
  • Conducting Market Research: Analyse market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities for seller acquisition.
  • Negotiating Contracts: Negotiate terms and agreements with sellers to secure the best deals.
  • Collaborating with Internal Teams: Work closely with other teams to ensure a seamless onboarding process for new sellers.

lists.text: To be successful in this role, you should be:
lists.content:
• University Degree qualified in a relevant field (Business, Commerce, Marketing etc).
  • Commercially savvy, with demonstrated experience and success within a commercial role, preferably within a Retail or eCommerce environment.
  • Highly analytical and logical, and always looking for new areas of opportunity.
  • Able to develop strong relationships, through excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Have developed exceptional time management skills, being able to effectively manage multiple projects and timelines successfully.
  • Tech savvy and able to use various IT and cloud-based tools to improve efficiency and productivity.
  • An AI enthusiast who is proficient in leveraging Artificial Intelligence tools to automate workflows, analyse data, and enhance decision-making speed.
  • Ready to challenge, be challenged, and work within our highly disruptive business model.

• Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape. You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry  with us and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!

descriptionPlain:
Due to rapid growth, we have an exciting opportunity for an experienced, data-driven Category Manager - Gaming to join our Purchasing team! Taking ownership of our gaming portfolio - spanning gaming & handheld consoles, PC hardware, gaming peripherals, accessories, and gaming tech - you will be the commercial driving force behind curating our product range and having full P&L ownership. You will ensure Kogan.com customers always have access to the most sought-after, trending gaming gear on the market..
Reporting directly to the Head of Consumer Electronics / Director of Purchasing, you will have true end-to-end ownership of your categories. You will be responsible for identifying margin opportunities, commercial dealmaking, developing exciting new products, cultivating strong global supplier partnerships, managing P&L responsibilities, and leveraging the latest market data and AI tools to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving gaming industry.
This is the ideal role for you if:
You are an experienced Category Manager / Buyer with a proven track record in gaming, consumer electronics, or tech-adjacent retail.
You are a senior Assistant Category Manager / Associate Buyer / Junior Buyer with solid category management experience ready to step up to take on a full, autonomous ownership of a major category portfolio.
You possess deep commercial acumen paired with genuine industry knowledge of gaming trends, hardware cycles, and brand ecosystems.
You live and breathe all things Digital, Consumer Tech and Electronics (ideally with a gaming twist) and understand the nature of the competitive retail landscape
If you are outcome-focused, commercially sharp, are fired up to grow the gaming & consumer tech space, and seek a challenge, apply today to take the next major step in your career!
description:
Due to rapid growth, we have an exciting opportunity for an experienced, data-driven Category Manager - Gaming to join our Purchasing team! Taking ownership of our gaming portfolio - spanning gaming & handheld consoles, PC hardware, gaming peripherals, accessories, and gaming tech - you will be the commercial driving force behind curating our product range and having full P&L ownership. You will ensure Kogan.com customers always have access to the most sought-after, trending gaming gear on the market..

Reporting directly to the Head of Consumer Electronics / Director of Purchasing, you will have true end-to-end ownership of your categories. You will be responsible for identifying margin opportunities, commercial dealmaking, developing exciting new products, cultivating strong global supplier partnerships, managing P&L responsibilities, and leveraging the latest market data and AI tools to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving gaming industry.

This is the ideal role for you if:

  • You are an experienced Category Manager / Buyer with a proven track record in gaming, consumer electronics, or tech-adjacent retail.

  • You are a senior Assistant Category Manager / Associate Buyer / Junior Buyer with solid category management experience ready to step up to take on a full, autonomous ownership of a major category portfolio.

  • You possess deep commercial acumen paired with genuine industry knowledge of gaming trends, hardware cycles, and brand ecosystems.

  • You live and breathe all things Digital, Consumer Tech and Electronics (ideally with a gaming twist) and understand the nature of the competitive retail landscape

If you are outcome-focused, commercially sharp, are fired up to grow the gaming & consumer tech space, and seek a challenge, apply today to take the next major step in your career!

lists.text: In this role you'll be responsible for:
lists.content:
• Identifying key commercial opportunities to expand the gaming & technology portfolio, including sourcing and developing high-margin products across global brands and Kogan.com’s Exclusive Brands.
  • Engaging, negotiating, and onboarding key local and international suppliers and brand partners to secure exclusive deals, market-leading pricing, and optimal trading terms.
  • Managing a cadence of daily category operations, range management, deal buys, inventory turns, margin mix, coordinating logistics and controlling a promotional rhythm to consistently meet and exceed monthly revenue and gross profit targets.
  • Driving dynamic pricing strategies across multiple sales channels to maintain market competitiveness while maximising profitability.
  • Conducting demand forecasting, maintaining optimal stock levels, and managing product lifecycles -from launch to end-of-life clearance - to prevent overstocking and stockouts.
  • Partnering closely with Marketing, Content, Promotions and Logistics teams to optimise product discoverability, campaign execution, and the overall customer buying journey.
  • Conducting regular range reviews, category analysis and deep-dive reporting on category performance, using data-driven insights  to make quick, agile adjustments.

lists.text: To be successful in this role, you should be:
lists.content:
• A University Degree in Business, Commerce, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • Category Management / Buying / Planning experience within eCommerce, Retail, or FMCG - specifically managing Gaming, Technology, or Consumer Electronics portfolios.
  • Deep insight into gaming hardware, peripherals, emerging tech trends, and key global/local distributor networks.
  • Strong analytical capability and P&L management experience, with a track record of identifying growth opportunities and driving margin expansion.
  • Excellent communication and vendor management skills with a proven ability to negotiate top-tier trading terms and pricing structures.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (data modelling, complex formulas, pivot tables, lookup functions).
  • Comfort with modern IT/cloud tools and an eagerness to leverage AI tools to streamline workflows, automate reporting, and boost productivity.
  • A thrive-under-pressure mindset tailored for a fast-paced, highly disruptive, agile eCommerce environment.

• Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape. You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry  with us and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!

descriptionPlain:
Our Marketing team has a fantastic opportunity for a CRM Coordinator to join the team! Reporting through to our Head of Loyalty and Performance Marketing, you'll be responsible for supporting the delivery of CRM programs across Kogan's stores and brands, analysing data and reporting, plus managing a range of marketing automation projects.
This role is perfect for a driven digital marketer looking to take the next step in their career, utilizing their existing foundation in CRM and lifecycle marketing to deliver high-quality work and enable an exceptional experience for our customers! This is a fantastic opportunity to bring your proven knowledge of digital campaigns to an industry-leading eCommerce retailer and truly own your development.
If you love working with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and want to further develop your skills, you’re in luck - this is a core component of the role!
If you're looking to elevate your Digital Marketing career, this is a fantastic opportunity to work in an industry-leading and innovative space, providing exposure to how an ASX listed, eCommerce pioneer runs!

If you love working with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and want to further develop your skills, you’re in luck - this is a core component of the role!

If you're looking to elevate your Digital Marketing career, this is a fantastic opportunity to work in an industry-leading and innovative space, providing exposure to how an ASX listed, eCommerce pioneer runs!

lists.text: In this role you'll be responsible for:
lists.content:
• Supporting the delivery of CRM programs across Kogan's brands, including segmentation, deliverability, analysis and reporting
  • Building and maintaining audience segmentation for store campaigns to drive targeted, relevant customer communications
  • Maintaining and QAing personalised marketing automation sends and customer journeys via Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC)
  • Monitoring and reporting on CRM performance, providing regular insights and recommendations to drive business outcomes
  • Supporting the Loyalty team's management of paid membership programmes, providing data and insights to inform, progress, and analyse the program
  • Monitoring email deliverability and recommending improvements against benchmarks where performance falls short
  • Partnering and coordinating with the broader Marketing and Marketing Operations teams on planning, execution and data needs

lists.text: To be successful in this role, you should be:
lists.content:
• University Degree qualified in a relevant field (Marketing, Analytics, Communications or similar)
  • Exposed to or experienced with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (or a similar Marketing Automation tool), which will be highly regarded
  • Experienced in, or have been exposed to, CRM and email marketing principles, preferably in a Retail or eCommerce environment
  • Highly analytical and ready to delve into data. You'll be working in the detail, using data to drive business decisions and make recommendations on what you find!
  • Tech-savvy and AI-forward. You have an interest in or exposure to utilizing AI tools (like ChatGPT, Claude, or built-in CRM predictive tools) to help brainstorm copy, streamline workflows, or analyse customer segments faster
  • Able to multitask effectively - we expect you to juggle 50 different tasks at once without dropping the ball (we're not kidding)
  • Inquisitive and ready to be challenged - we're not afraid of putting in hard work to deliver a superior product!

• Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape
  • You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry  with us and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!

descriptionPlain:
We're looking for  customer-centric and solutions-focused team members to help drive the Kogan.com experience! Our Customer Care team is our direct eyes and ears to our customers, and the feedback that they receive helps us to constantly improve the Kogan.com customer experience. By striving to make every customer experience a positive one, they're able to facilitate the growth of our business!  
 
In this role, you’ll be responsible for delivering an outstanding customer experience by resolving queries, supporting best practice, and acting as a strong advocate for our customers.
 
Whether you're a recent graduate to kick off their career or have a passion for tech and exceptional customer experiences, this is a fantastic role to work within a dynamic, fast-paced and innovative space and be part of an iconic, ASX listed eCommerce business!

lists.text: In this role you'll be responsible for:
lists.content:
• Taking ownership of escalated customer queries and issues, ensuring timely and effective resolution via Salesforce, SAP, phone and other systems.
  • Providing one-on-one support to customers via email and phone, always representing Kogan.com with professionalism and empathy.
  • Processing customer refunds, credits and replacements accurately and efficiently.
  • Liaising with freight carriers to ensure prompt and reliable delivery of orders.
  • Collaborating with internal teams to resolve queries and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience.
  • Staying up to date with Kogan.com products and trends to provide informed advice to customers.
  • Contributing to the smooth operation of the Customer Care team by ensuring all tasks are completed with accuracy and efficiency.
  • Assisting with the creation, testing, documentation and rollout of new processes
  • Supporting training and development by assisting with onboarding, shadow sessions, and capability building for overseas agents.

lists.text: To be successful in this role, you should be:
lists.content:
• A University Degree will be highly regarded, but is not essential
  • Customer centric and willing to go above and beyond to ensure our customers have an exceptional experience
  • An effective and empathetic communicator. You'll be able to articulately and clearly engage via different channels, including phone and email
  • Tech-savvy and ability to use various IT and cloud-based tools to improve efficiency and productivity
  • Have an excellent attention to detail, with an ability to move through volume tasks with accuracy and efficiency
  • An excellent multitasker  – you’ll be managing multiple projects and priorities at once, keeping everything on track without missing a beat
  • Ready to challenge, be challenged, and work within our highly disruptive business model.

• Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand’s eCommerce future
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape
  • You’ll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact
  • You’ll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry  with us and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!

descriptionPlain:
Kogan.com is a pioneer of Australian eCommerce, and the software we build is used by millions of customers every day. You'll join a fast-moving engineering team with real ownership, shipping to production daily and using AI as part of how we work.
 
As a Data Engineer you'll design and run the data and ML pipelines that let teams across Marketing, Purchasing, Logistics and Finance make confident, data-driven decisions.
description:
Kogan.com is a pioneer of Australian eCommerce, and the software we build is used by millions of customers every day. You'll join a fast-moving engineering team with real ownership, shipping to production daily and using AI as part of how we work.
 
As a Data Engineer you'll design and run the data and ML pipelines that let teams across Marketing, Purchasing, Logistics and Finance make confident, data-driven decisions.

lists.content:
• Scalable Pipeline Development: Design and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines capable of handling 10M+ daily events and large-scale data transfers across our platforms.

  • Data Modeling: Develop and optimize data models in environments like BigQuery or Snowflake to ensure high performance for both analytics and ML training sets with optimal cost

  • Support ML Workflows: Build the underlying features and data inputs required for Machine Learning models

  • Develop and refine ML models for practical business use cases, such as customer sentiment, churn prediction or demand forecasting

  • MLOps Integration: Establish and maintain MLOps pipelines to help automate the deployment and monitoring of models in production.

  • System Integration: Work with internal APIs and third-party tools to ingest data efficiently while maintaining strict data integrity.

  • Governance & Quality: Implement best practices for data quality, security, and documentation to ensure our data remains a "source of truth."

  • Development according to software engineering best practices (Git, CI/CD, trunk based development, tests)

  • AI Collaboration: Contribute to experiments with AI and LLMs to assess how they can be practically applied to solve business problems.

• Strong SQL Foundations: Solid experience writing and optimizing SQL for commercial-scale products (e.g., handling millions of rows and complex joins efficiently).

  • Pipeline Orchestration: Proven experience using tools like Airflow, dbt, or AWS Glue to manage and monitor production-grade data workflows.

  • Python Proficiency: Strong Python skills for data transformation, scripting and interacting with various data sources.

  • ML Engineering Exposure: Practical experience building the data infrastructure that supports machine learning, including data preprocessing and model deployment pipelines. Experience with machine learning models development

  • Cloud Experience: Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms, with a strong preference for GCP.

  • Software Best Practices: Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and basic containerization (Docker) to ensure code quality and deployment reliability.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A practical approach to engineering that balances the need for speed with long-term system stability.

    •  
    Bonus Points

  • Experience with event streaming (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis) for real-time data needs.

  • Exposure to ML platforms and tools such as SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Databricks.

  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools like Looker or Tableau.

  • An interest in eCommerce dynamics and customer behavior analytics.

• Our culture is unlike anywhere else and regardless of where you are in your career journey, we empower you to do your best work and have a big impact. Check us out https://devblog.kogan.com/ & https://goodteams.app/teams/kogan.com.
  • Work with an incredible team to solve important challenges, helping to drive Australia and New Zealand's eCommerce future.
  • Your role has a lot of ownership, autonomy and little red tape. You'll be empowered to achieve positive outcomes and your work will have a real impact.
  • You'll be at the forefront of the eCommerce industry and be part of a company that are the Pioneers of eCommerce in Australia.
  • Be an Intrepreneur, playing a hands on role in shaping our strategy at our HQ.
  • Learning budget of $1000.
  • A range of employee benefits such as; complimentary Kogan First Membership, team exclusive discounts, Health & Wellness program, Learning & Development and Lunch & Learns, Hackathons, Team member referral program, Company and team events and celebrations, community engagement (volunteering) and extensive career development opportunities plus loads more!
